title: The Essence of Christian Mysticism (retreat DVD set, Bernadette's Friends / bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com, 2004 or 2012)
duration: about 9 hours of talks in 4 files, plus handouts
host: Bernadette Roberts official site (Recorded Talks page), managed by Pat Masters for Bernadette's Friends
description: Recording of the retreat Roberts gave annually for about 30 years, presenting the essence of Christian mysticism as Trinity, Christ and Faith; nine hours of talks in four files with handouts, offered as a DVD set (Wikipedia also lists a CD) through her site. She regarded it as a prerequisite for The Real Christ; the nine-hour series ends with questions and answers. Dates conflict: Wikipedia bibliography 2004 (CD) and 2012 (DVD) in different versions; 1994 elsewhere. The site states there are no authorized videos or audio of her on YouTube or any other site. Phoenix Kennedy's Kindle 'Commentary on The Essence of Christian Mysticism' is written to accompany the videos.

title: A Passage Through Self (talk on DVD, students of Bernadette / Center for Sacred Sciences library, 1987)
duration: 55 minutes (CSS library copy); the two-DVD set sold from her site is described by a viewer as a three-hour talk
host: Center for Sacred Sciences library (CSS Library, TinyCat); DVD also offered on bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com Recorded Talks page
description: Her talk illustrating the spiritual journey in terms of consciousness with a series of circles (paper circles with partly punched-out centres: 'the circles course'), first given after The Experience of No-Self was published, when she was invited to speak around the country. Covers the falling away of the ego, dark night of the spirit, unitive state, the 'marketplace' stage and the final falling away of self. CSS library record: 1 video recording, 55 min, imprint 'United States: students of Bernadette, 1987'; the record notes several recordings are available online courtesy of Pat Masters and other students. A Shalom Place member reviewed a two-DVD set ordered from her website (about three hours). Wikipedia dates the DVD 2012 in one version of its list, 1987 in another. Required viewing for her Fullerton retreats (e.g. 2014).

title: Interview with Bernadette Roberts (CD sound recording, Center for Sacred Sciences library, 1987)
host: Center for Sacred Sciences library (CSS Library, TinyCat)
description: Interview recording catalogued in the Center for Sacred Sciences (Eugene, Oregon) library as 'Interview with Bernadette Roberts [sound recording]', CD, 1987, barcode CD-0931, shelved at the front desk. Interviewer not shown in search results. Lending copy only.

title: The Passion of Grace (radio interview, New Dimensions Radio, 1991)
host: New Dimensions Radio (New Dimensions Foundation, Ukiah, California)
description: New Dimensions program 2276, interview with Michael Toms dated 1991-08-01, on allowing grace into one's life despite its surprising consequences. Sold as an MP3 download ($1.99) from the New Dimensions archive store (also mirrored at reach.dog); streamed on TuneIn; distributed as an audiobook (ISBN 9781987138269) via Everand, Hoopla, Libro.fm and Storytel. Featured in the New Dimensions 'Networks of Grace' spotlight of 2019-11-06 (and later 'Networks of Grace' spotlights, 2022). The New Dimensions Media records (incl. master tapes) are held at Stanford Special Collections.

title: Nonduality as a Definition of Christ (conference talk, Science and Nonduality (SAND), San Jose, 2015)
host: Science and Nonduality (SAND) conference, SAND15 US
description: Roberts presented the paper 'Nonduality as a Definition of Christ' at the SAND conference in San Jose on 22 October 2015 (paper text offered on her Papers for Download page). An attendee recalls seeing her present in person. No audio or video recording of the session was found in search results; SAND's archive and YouTube channel are where a recording would be.

title: Bernadette Roberts on the Logos, Cosmic Christ, and blood/spirit/soul (DVD excerpt, YouTube, The Essence of Christian Mysticism)
description: Third-party YouTube excerpt from her recorded retreat DVD series 'The Essence of Christian Mysticism', on the Logos and its connection to the Cosmic Christ, and on blood, spirit and soul. Her official site states no YouTube recordings of her are authorized.

title: Bernadette Roberts on why Christ is not in Christianity (DVD excerpt, YouTube, The Essence of Christian Mysticism)
description: 41-minute excerpt from the DVDs 'The Essence of Christian Mysticism' (uploader describes them as four-hour DVDs), on why Christ is not in Christianity. Used as the 'full video' source for the Dancing Paradox podcast episode 'Why Christ Is Not In Christianity'. Unauthorized per her official site.

title: Bernadette Roberts on the Resurrection and Ascension speaking from experience (DVD excerpt, YouTube, The Essence of Christian Mysticism)
description: Her reply to a question at the end of the nine-hour 'Essence of Christian Mysticism' retreat series, on the Resurrection and Ascension, speaking from experience. Third-party upload; unauthorized per her official site.

title: Bernadette Roberts on the Eucharist (DVD excerpt, YouTube, bernadetterobertsisnotmyguru.com)
host: YouTube (upload watermarked www.bernadetterobertsisnotmyguru.com, i.e. Phoenix Kennedy)
description: Excerpt on the Eucharist; the video carries the watermark www.bernadetterobertsisnotmyguru.com. Companion clip 'on being transformed into the Eucharist' (DsuWkp8TCgM) continues the discussion with a personal story.

title: Bernadette Roberts retreat talks free to view (retreat videos, announced by Aquarian Catholic Spiritual Community, 2021)
host: Unnamed website, announced by the Aquarian Catholic Spiritual Community
description: A 2021 devotional post announced that the recorded 'retreat' talks Roberts gave over her lifetime were available to view at no cost, warning they are long. The hosting site and which retreat is shown are not named in search results.

title: Bernadette Roberts | The Path To No Self (podcast excerpt, Dancing Paradox, 2023)
host: Dancing Paradox podcast (Alex Hickman), Podbean; also Apple Podcasts, Audible, Metacast, Podtail
description: Episode 156 of Dancing Paradox, dated 2023-01-21: an excerpt of Roberts herself speaking about the experience of no-self, taken from a YouTube video that the episode notes link to. Free podcast; Audible listings B0BSRR9KL7 (US) and B0BSRYZ5ZP (UK).
